title: Microsoft Fires 10K, Hires AI Instead
full_monologue: **Microsoft Just Fired 10,000 People and Hired AI Instead**. This isn’t science fiction—it’s happening now. Companies are racing to automate, and Microsoft is leading the charge. But what does this mean for the future of work? While some jobs disappear, new ones emerge. The question is: are we ready for an AI-driven economy? Let me know your thoughts in the comments.
